title: Bottom Row: V and N
description: Introduce V and N. Left index reaches down to V, right index to N.

exercises.text: vvvv nnnn vvvv nnnn
fvfv jnjn fvfv jnjn
vnvn vnvn nvnv nvnv
van van van and and and even even
a van; a van; even now; even now;

reviewMaterial: Index fingers dip down to V and N, then return to F and J.

title: Bottom Row: B and M
description: Add B and M. Left index on B, right index on M.

exercises.text: bbbb mmmm bbbb mmmm
fbfb jmjm fbfb jmjm
bmbm bmbm mbmb mbmb
be be be me me me from from
be me; be me; from me; from me;

reviewMaterial: B and M are reached by the same index fingers that handle V and N.

title: Bottom Row: C and Comma
description: Introduce C and the comma. Left middle finger on C, right middle on comma.

exercises.text: cccc ,,,, cccc ,,,,
dcdc k,k, dcdc k,k,
c,c, c,c, ,c,c ,c,c
can can can call call, call,
can you, can you, call me,

reviewMaterial: Middle fingers reach down. Comma is used often in English.

title: Bottom Row: X and Period
description: Add X and the period. Left ring on X, right ring on period.

exercises.text: xxxx .... xxxx ....
sxsx l.l. sxsx l.l.
x.x. x.x. .x.x .x.x
box box box six six. six.
a box. a box. six boxes.

reviewMaterial: Period ends sentences. Practice the downward reach carefully.

title: Bottom Row: Z and Slash
description: Complete the bottom row with Z and the slash key.

exercises.text: zzzz //// zzzz ////
azaz ;/;/ azaz ;/;/
z/z/ z/z/ /z/z /z/z
size size size jazz jazz zero zero
a size / a size / zero / zero

reviewMaterial: Z is the farthest left bottom key. Stretch the pinky gently.

title: Full Bottom Row
description: Practice the entire bottom letter row together.

exercises.text: zxcv zxcv bnm, bnm, ./ ./
zxcvbnm,./ zxcvbnm,./
can van ban man, can van ban man.
next next next box box mix mix
next, mix the box. next, mix the box.

reviewMaterial: Bottom row requires more finger travel. Stay relaxed.

title: All Letters: Short Words
description: Type common short words using the full alphabet.

exercises.text: the and for you are not but can
have this that with from they will
what when where which while while
about after again against almost always
the quick brown fox jumps

reviewMaterial: You now have the full alphabet. Focus on accuracy over speed.

title: Alphabet Combinations
description: Drill letter combinations across all rows.

exercises.text: ab cd ef gh ij kl mn op qr st uv wx yz
za xb yc vd we uf tg sh ri qj pk ol nm
pack pack jack jack back back
quick quick brown brown jumps jumps
the lazy dog; the lazy dog;

reviewMaterial: Crossing between rows builds finger independence.

title: Common Words Set A

exercises.text: time time time year year year way way
day day day man man man thing thing
woman woman life life child child
world world school school state state
family family student student group group

reviewMaterial: These words appear constantly in everyday typing.

title: Common Words Set B

exercises.text: work work work place place place case case
point point point company company number number
problem problem fact fact hand hand
part part part place place place week week
system system program program question question

reviewMaterial: Build muscle memory for the most common word shapes.

title: Letter Mastery Drill
description: Focused drill on the full alphabet in sequence and reverse.

exercises.text: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba
abc def ghi jkl mno pqr stu vwx yz
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs

reviewMaterial: Pangrams test every letter. Aim for clean, even strokes.

title: Short Word Fluency
description: Rapid short-word sequences to build rhythm.

exercises.text: is it to be or not to be that is
do we go up or do we go down now
he has his own way and she has hers
if you can then you will and so will i
one two three four five six seven eight

reviewMaterial: Keep a steady rhythm. Do not rush and create errors.

title: Medium Words

exercises.text: people people people because because before before
between between under under through through
during during without without against against
another another something something everything
important important different different possible

reviewMaterial: Longer words train sequential finger patterns.

title: Alphabet in Context
description: Type natural phrases that use the full alphabet.

exercises.text: please fix the broken jazz equipment
how quickly daft jumping zebras vex
the five boxing wizards jump quickly
jackdaws love my big sphinx of quartz
crazy frederick bought many very exquisite opal jewels

reviewMaterial: Pangram sentences are excellent full-alphabet practice.

title: Complete Alphabet Review
description: Final review of all alphabetic keys before word-focused training.

exercises.text: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs
we can type every letter with skill and care
practice makes progress when you type each day

reviewMaterial: Alphabet complete. Next you will master common words and sentences.
